gantry.note: unbounded along the quay rail in the twin; this range is for the asset viewer

trolley.note: from the waterside rail; 68 m outreach [V], 18 m backreach behind the landside rail [A]

hoist.note: spreader underside height above the rail: 52 m lift [V]; 20 m below the rail into the hold [A]

twin_locks.note: lowered = twin-20 lift (inner castings of two 20 ft boxes)

stretch.note: ropes.scale.y = ropes.y - (hoist.y + offsetM), both children of the trolley
rotate forestays so local +Y points at forestay_anchor (a boom child) and set scale.y = distance; the rods stay on the apex and the boom nose at every boom angle
rotate boom_hoist_ropes so local +Y points at boom_hoist_anchor and set scale.y = distance; the ropes run from the apex head sheaves to the boom sheave block and shorten as the boom rises

LOD0.note: camera to crane centre; the renderer adds 15 % hysteresis

branding.placement: TTI over ALGECIRAS on the machinery house sides and seaward end (blue on white), TTI ALGECIRAS on the main girder outer faces and on the boom side plate outer faces (white on blue), ZPMC builder plates on the legs

boomSidePlate.note: solid plate on both boom girders seaward of the hinge (every LOD, so the silhouette matches); TTI ALGECIRAS lettering on its outer faces at LOD0 and LOD1, from the sts-atlas region, in the paint material (no extra draw call); rides with the boom

craneNumbers.placement: seaward and landward portal beams, landside end of the machinery house
craneNumbers.uvConvention: TEXCOORD_0 of material sts_plate is authored for tile 0 (crane 101); add (index % cols, floor(index / cols)) * tileSizeUv

branding.note: text only (open-licence typeface), no logo artwork

provenance.fact: 52 m lift height above rail (hoist travel maximum)
68 m seaward outreach from the waterside rail (trolley travel minimum)

provenance.reason: builder version: real fleet is 5 Malaccamax + 3 Super Post-Panamax

provenance.fact: blue steelwork, white machinery house, yellow spreader, lattice boom, ties, ladders, catwalks, floodlights
apex, trolley-rail and hinge heights, leg spacing, backreach, bogie layout, house size
wordmarks set in Archivo ExtraBold; crane numbers 101-124 on plates

TTI ALGECIRAS livery: cobalt-blue steel, white machinery house with a sloped seaward nose and TTI / ALGECIRAS text, TTI ALGECIRAS text along the girders, ZPMC plates on the legs, crane number plates, X-braced side frames, long forestay rods from the apex to the boom nose, amber beacons
provenance.source: TTI Algeciras reference photographs of the STS cranes (git-ignored, not committed)

provenance.fact: no TTI emblem or logo artwork

provenance.reason: photos show amber beacons low on the legs; exact heights are estimated

provenance.fact: forestays are straight rods that stretch to stay on the apex and the boom nose; boom-hoist ropes run straight from the apex to a sheave block on the outer overhead frame (no reeving)
provenance.reason: real forestays are hinged links that fold as the boom rises; simplified to one aimed stretch node each

provenance.fact: LOD1 headblock and twin-lift housing merged into the spreader mesh; no boom-hoist ropes at LOD2
provenance.reason: per-LOD draw-call caps (10 at LOD1, 6 at LOD2)

provenance.fact: ladder cages, handrail posts and festoon loops simplified

#300 added: deeper boom side plate with TTI ALGECIRAS lettering (every LOD; lettering LOD0 and LOD1), extra A-frame and apex diagonal bracing (LOD0), zig-zag service stairs on the landward face of the -X landside leg (LOD0), a slightly larger machinery house (every LOD, no extra triangles)
provenance.source: TTI reference photographs A01, A04, B01 (link-only) and the CC0 set; sizes [A]

provenance.fact: #300 skipped for budget: nothing; LOD1 and LOD2 gain only the side plate (lettering also at LOD1); the house grows at every LOD so it does not pop at the LOD switch
provenance.reason: spec #297 LOD0 ceiling 33,274 triangles (5 % over the 31,690 before the spec) and the per-LOD draw-call caps
